correctness.rationale: For noncritical c, the m roots of p(x)=c are simple and nonzero. The quadric projection has m local Morse zeros, with regular fiber q=1 homotopy S^{n-2} and star-shaped local total spaces. Regular square-root bundle trivializations and a graph-spine homotopy pushout yield a mapping torus plus m cones; quotienting the first fiber yields S1 wedge S^{n-1}, and the remaining attachments add the remaining m-1 spheres. Smoothness, nonproper-fibration handling and Euler characteristic checks appear in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: Determines the full integral homotopy type, fundamental group and an exact arbitrary rank m of middle-dimensional spheres for infinitely many explicit generic rational-function fibers, directly addressing a homotopy conclusion recently left conjectural beyond cohomology. The method isolates an interpretable monodromy-independent mechanism, more substantial than a low-degree calculation or routine numerical increment.
